verdict.rationale: Alloy is a hosted identity and fraud decisioning platform. Asking whether a SaaS platform offers self-hosting or on-prem deployment is a fair axis, so this is not a category error. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-hosting, on-prem deployment, or a downloadable core product; the docs describe only hosted APIs, webhooks, workflows, and a status page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
